label: symlink-engine check returns 0 unconditionally: inspect() computes missing/broken/foreign-link/source-missing per runtime, the check branch emits the report and returns 0, and no flag can change that. Fix: return 1 on any drift status plus an --allow-drift escape, so /doctor:symlink --check becomes a usable CI gate.

checkHooks grants PASS from the global hooks path: git rev-parse --git-path hooks honours core.hooksPath, so a repo with nothing installed resolves to the global dir and every name realpaths into ownDir, making accepted.includes() trivially true. Repro run: a fresh repo reports ~/.config/git/hooks, and with -c core.hooksPath=<checkout>/scripts/git-hooks it reports ownDir. Fix: resolve the repo-local .git/hooks via --git-common-dir and accept core.hooksPath only when it is set locally.
verify: R=$(mktemp -d /tmp/chkhooks.XXXXXX) && git -C "$R" init -q && git -C "$R" rev-parse --git-path hooks

label: The sk-git CI job runs 1 of 5 suites: sk-git-script-tests.yml:51 invokes only worktree-naming.test.sh while scripts/tests holds commit-id-naming, migrate-legacy-branch-names, stamp-branch, worktree-naming and validate-message-git-timeout. Fix: five named steps in the same job so a regression names its suite.

agents-md-manifest --check has no CI caller: its --check contract compares derived with the root documents, yet grep -rln agents-md .github/workflows/ returns nothing, so AGENTS.md can desync from the manifest unnoticed. Fix: one build-free step running the checker in an existing workflow.

RUNTIME_MIRRORS covers 3 of 7 runtime trees: the list holds opencode, claude and codex only, while .claude/.opencode/.codex/.cursor/.pi/.devin/.dsh all ship agents directories (13/12/11/11/11/11/11 files). Edits to .pi, .cursor, .devin or .dsh agents pass the parity gate unseen. Fix: add pi (required), cursor, devin, and a patch-yml format for dsh.

Two canonical agent roots disagree: .skilled/agents/README.txt:9 says a file absent from that directory is not a live surface, yet .claude/agents/Explore.md is a live 15-line haiku agent with no canonical source, and the parity gate enumerates canonical names only so a mirror-only file is never seen. Fix: add the reverse roster direction (mirror file with no canonical source fails, README* allowlisted) or adopt Explore.md.

The parity gate runs a copy of itself: agent-mirror-sync.yml:57 points CHECKER at .opencode/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs, a regular 8,227-byte file (readlink prints nothing) not a symlink, duplicating .skilled/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs at the same size. Nothing checks the two agree; removing the copy breaks nothing because the canonical path exists in every checkout. Fix: point CHECKER at the canonical path.

Three doctor checkers answer the same mirror question: agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs (228 lines), the bin pair check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs + lib/mirror-sync-verify.cjs, and roster rows inside command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs (460 lines). Only the bin pair has a CI caller, so removing the doctor roster checker costs only that doctor row. Surface total: 17 routes, 41 YAML assets, 24 engines (24,679 lines) and 15 libs (5,416 lines). Fix: have the doctor row call the bin checker with --json.

One cheap wiring catches two P1s: extending the existing sk-git-script-tests.yml job with the four missing suites plus node .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-manifest.cjs --check costs one file and no new workflow, because both checks are pure node with no build step, and the existing vars.SKILLED_CI_TESTS switch already gates the job.

The printed hooks repair reproduces the false PASS: git-setup-check.cjs:366 prints "git config core.hooksPath <ownDir>" for a foreign repository, and an operator who runs it with --global makes every repository on the machine pass the check it was meant to fail. Fix: print --local and add a detail line when a global core.hooksPath is detected.
All six confirmed P1s now have a named file:line and a post-fix behaviour, and three of them (F15-01, F15-03, F15-04) collapse into a single build-free CI job.

Measured over-engineering baseline for the doctor family: 17 routes, 41 YAML assets, 24 engines (24,679 lines), 15 libs (5,416 lines), 30,095 lines total, with the mirror question implemented three times.
